semantics.out_or_bitwise: Each bit i is a[i] OR b[i].
semantics.out_or_logical: One when either input vector is nonzero; zero when both are zero.
semantics.out_not: Bits [5:3] are bitwise inverse of b; bits [2:0] are bitwise inverse of a.
semantics.timing: Combinational; original specification describes vector operations with no clock, reset, storage, or latency.
semantics.initialization: No initialized state specified or required; outputs follow inputs under Verilog four-state operator semantics.

numeric.interpretation: Bit vectors; inversion is within each 3-bit vector, with b above a.

verification.oracle_source: Original problem.txt vector operation and placement requirements.
verification.binary_cases: Exhaust all 64 a/b pairs using per-bit truth tables and a separate nonzero predicate.
verification.sampling: Sample after a 1 ns combinational settling interval, without clock or reset.
verification.unknown_cases: Additional directed X/Z cases exercise standard four-state OR and inversion semantics.
verification.termination: Fatal mismatch and bounded timeout; PASS emitted only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: X/Z input behavior is not explicitly described; use standard Verilog bitwise and logical operator semantics. No state or startup value is specified.
